name: Energized Dragon wing Attacks (Combat)
body:
Your wing attacks deal energy damage in addition to their normal damage.

Prerequisite(s): Str 15, wings bloodline power, Dragon Wing Attacks, 5th-level Dragon Disciple

Benefit: Your wing attacks deal an additional 1d6 points of damage of your energy type on a successful hit.
